title: 5D Painting
description: Rust desktop and browser studio that turns photographs and illustrations into printable diamond-painting or cross-stitch patterns: maps colors to DMC, Anchor, or Sulky thread catalogs, reduces and smooths the palette, previews tiled print pages, and exports PDF, PNG, SVG, Excel, or OXS charts.
highlights: Perceptual color matching against DMC (489), Anchor (442), and Sulky (333) thread catalogs, or the image's own colors
Custom pipeline: MMCQ/RgbQuant reduction, CIE76/CIE94/CIEDE2000 color distance, and five dithering algorithms
CAD-style editor with stone-level drawing tools, selections, colors as layers, and painter progress tracking
Actual-size tiled PDF, PNG/SVG, Excel, and OXS exports with material estimates per color
Six-crate Cargo workspace: native egui studio, the same studio in WebAssembly, an axum/Postgres account API, and a static site

title: Resources for Mac
description: Native macOS system monitor written in Rust with egui, inspired by GNOME Resources: an interactive bubble overview of apps and processes, per-resource pages, a menu bar extra, and a desktop widget.
highlights: Overview page: every app as a bubble around "This Mac", sized by memory or CPU, with launch relationships and process trees
Processor, memory, Apple Silicon GPU, drives, network, and battery pages
Menu bar stats and a live-graph desktop widget that keep running when the window is closed
End / Kill / Halt / Continue processes from Apps and Processes views
Universal dmg released via GitHub Actions and installable with Homebrew (brew install --cask VachaganGrigoryan/tap/resources-mac)

title: Formula
description: CAD-style formula workbench in Rust (egui/eframe) that runs natively and in the browser via WebAssembly. Every formula is a tool placed on a drafting canvas as a live, interactive viewport, with reference docs and ready-to-run visualization code.
highlights: Live viewports for projections, Bézier curves, Fourier epicycles, Lissajous figures, Mandelbrot, Perlin flow fields, Game of Life, Lorenz attractor, and more
Inspector with properties, reference documentation, and visualization code in Python, TypeScript, and Rust
Equations export to LaTeX with current parameter values or to a ready-to-run Jupyter notebook
Sorting visualizer with audio, using Web Audio in the browser and cpal on desktop
Single codebase for the desktop app and the WebAssembly build

title: SpecStat
description: GitHub-native, frontend-only spec management and visualization tool built on the OpenSpec convention. Connect a repo and explore specs as Jira-like cards, relationship graphs, folder trees, and timelines — with GitHub as the only backend (no server, no database).
highlights: GitHub is the only backend - no custom server and no database
Read-only and purely additive: never modifies your OpenSpec files
GitHub Action parses and indexes specs in CI (init/sync/validate/baseline)
Stories, Proposals (Kanban), Graph, Tree, and Timeline views
Turborepo monorepo: Next.js web app, parser, GitHub client, and Action runtime

title: Vogi
description: Realtime voice/chat platform: register, connect with other users, chat, send photos/video/voice messages, and make audio/video calls via WebRTC P2P, with an Android app integrated alongside the web app.
highlights: Presence-based connections - users ping each other and connect only after acceptance
WebRTC P2P audio/video calls with TURN/coturn fallback
Redis-backed Socket.IO scaling for realtime messaging and presence
Media messages (photos, video, voice) via object storage and RabbitMQ background jobs
Companion Android app alongside the web client
Rust microservices backend in progress, wire-compatible with the web client and moving storage from MongoDB to PostgreSQL

title: TiVi
category: IPTV player and companion management platform
description: IPTV ecosystem with a web companion app, Django backend, and an LG webOS TV application. Manage and sync playlists periodically and browse EPG program data for channels.
highlights: Web companion app to manage and periodically sync IPTV playlists
EPG program data browsing for channels
Django + PostgreSQL backend with worker-driven sync jobs
Native LG webOS TV app built with Enact.js and React

title: FastQL
description: Turns Python annotations into a complete GraphQL system: schema authoring, validation, execution, SDL, introspection, and framework integrations (FastAPI, Starlette, Django, Flask) through one coherent API.
highlights: Code-first GraphQL schema authoring via Python annotations and decorators
Full execution engine: validation, SDL export, introspection, subscriptions, incremental delivery
DataLoader, custom directives, Relay support, and Apollo Federation v2
Drop-in integrations for FastAPI, Starlette, Django, and Flask with OpenTelemetry tracing

title: TypeWall
description: Strict, schema-first runtime validation library for Python with deterministic validation, structured errors, immutable/composable schemas, JSON Schema/OpenAPI output, a CLI, and optional FastAPI integration.
highlights: Strict, schema-first runtime validation with deterministic, structured errors
Immutable, composable schemas with type-derived generation
JSON Schema / OpenAPI export plus a validation CLI
Optional FastAPI integration extra

title: Imperator
category: Rules compiler for AI coding agents
description: Open-source, stack-aware collection of reusable rules for AI coding agents. Rules live in one source tree and compile into each agent's native layout for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini.
highlights: Global behavior rules that cut wasted tokens and keep agents in scope
Domain rules per stack (Python, TypeScript, Postgres, Docker, and more) and role-based specialist subagents
Compiles one rule policy into .claude/, .cursor/rules/, AGENTS.md + .codex/, or GEMINI.md + .gemini/
CLI with init, profiles, compile, doctor, and clean commands

title: tasgi
description: "Thread ASGI" - an experimental ASGI-compatible framework/runtime that keeps transport and protocol handling on the event loop while allowing handler execution on the asyncio loop or a thread runtime.
highlights: ASGI-compatible runtime keeping transport/protocol I/O on the event loop
Handler execution on asyncio or a dedicated thread runtime
HTTP, WebSocket, routing, and OpenAPI support
Experimental concurrency model exploring event-loop safety with thread offloading

title: pybi
description: Go-based CLI project generator for Python application templates, driven by external catalog repositories that define stacks, features, and renderable templates.
highlights: Go-based CLI that scaffolds Python project templates
Driven by external catalog repositories (python-templates) defining stacks and features
Catalog metadata via catalog.json, catalog.model.json, and catalog.full.json
Automated releases via GoReleaser and GitHub Actions

title: Family Tree
category: Family tree builder and visualization tool
description: Build family trees, manage members and relationships, generate visualizations, and export the tree as PNG or PDF, with Supabase-backed auth (including Google) and data storage.
highlights: Build and manage family trees with members and relationships
Visual tree rendering with PNG and PDF export
Supabase-backed auth (including Google) and data storage
Deployed on Vercel

title: Resume Builder
description: Frontend-only CV builder focused on privacy: build resumes from multiple templates without sending personal data to a backend, edit locally, and export/save resume data as JSON.
highlights: Multiple CV templates with fully local editing - no backend involved
Export and re-import resume data as JSON
Privacy-first, client-side-only architecture

title: Freestudio
description: Browser-based creative editing app inspired by Photoshop-like workflows, exploring lightweight in-browser alternatives for image and design editing.
highlights: Browser-based, Photoshop-inspired image editing workflows
Fully client-side creative tooling experiment
Built with Vite, React, and TypeScript
